title: Points lift to the punctured monic root cover
statement: For a commutative ring R, g in R, a positive natural n, y in Spec R and g not in the prime y, put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), q:Spec A to Spec R and V=D(algebraMap R A g), using def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions. There exists v in V with (V inclusion followed by q)(v)=y. Invertibility of n is not required.

source.place: Tag 0EYG, off-divisor branch; standard basic-open localization and monic root algebra calculation

proof.text: The hypothesis g not in y gives g != 0 and hence Nontrivial R. The polynomial f=X^n-C(g) is monic with degree n>0. The closed source theorem AdjoinRoot.faithfullyFlat_of_monic gives faithful flatness: its proof constructs the power basis with n elements and observes its nonemptiness.

Apply Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat to obtain a prime v above y. By the definition of comap, algebraMap(g) belongs to v exactly when g belongs to y. Thus v belongs to V and its subtype point gives the required lift.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EYG motivates the off-divisor application; the explicit algebraic and scheme argument is written here and completely checked by Lean.
